contenders.handicapper_notes: Dominant form standout in this 2YO maiden sprint. Ran an exceptional second on debut at Ellis Park going 5.5F over turf, missing by just a neck while posting a field-best 111 speed figure and 113 class rating. Lands meet-leading turf pilot Jose Ortiz for Mark Casse. Holds a commanding experience and speed figure edge over this juvenile field.

Encountered a severely compromised start on debut over this track and distance when steadied at the break, yet still registered a 113 speed rating. Returned with a blazing bullet 4F workout in 48.95 (5/25) on August 5 at Saratoga. Positioned for major progression second out with a clean break.

First-time starter by Violence out of a Hard Spun dam for trainer John Servis and Hall of Fame rider John Velazquez. Shows sharp morning drills including a bullet 3F gate work in 35.86 (1/5) at Parx. Must overcome the 2YO experience edge penalty against proven stakes-caliber turf debut runners.

Cuts back sharply in distance after flashing early speed and setting the pace to deep stretch in a 1 1/16M turf route at Saratoga on July 24 before yielding late. The turnback to 5.5F turf sprint suits her natural front-running style under Jaime Rodriguez.
